node.title: Re^2: capture optional text
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
while (chomp(my $line = )) {

This won't work if the final line doesn't end on a newline, as [doc://chomp] returns the number of newlines it removed. Better to use the traditional while () { chomp; ... or while (my $line = ) { chomp($line); ... Update: Plus, even with a trailing newline, the code generates a warning, since after the final line, the loop condition is executed one more time, and will return undef and chomp(my $line = undef) causes a warning.
